newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks sparkle to end at record highs.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks sparkle to end at record highs.

text.p: 1620 GMT - Madrid stocks ended briskly higher on Thursday, with both general and Ibex indices showing a record high, dealers said.
* General index was up 9.05 points, or 2.1 percent, to 440.6
The buying pressure reflected a positive outlook for the coming year, dealers said, adding that more year-end support was still to come.
"It was a big rally but nobody wants to be left out of this market," a dealer said. Trading volume was high, taking into account that many European markets were on holiday.
Dealers added that a consolidation was very likely at this point, even though many added that any dip would be considered a good buying opportunity.
Virtually every sector was rising. Telefonica gained 1.34 percent and Repsol 1.72 percent.
In the Banking sector, Banesto rose 3.25 percent and BBV 2.65 percent. But BCH shares fell 0.3 percent.
Union Fenosa rose 7.3 percent and Sevillana 5.7 percent.
